admin.name: ops_metrics_query
admin.description: Run one named metrics/log lookup (Prometheus, Loki). Latency: gateway_latency_p95 (per route), grpc_latency_p95 (per service) - use these for 'which service is slowest'. Errors: gateway_5xx_ratio, grpc_error_rate, logs_errors(service). Load: gateway_request_rate, grpc_request_rate. State: alerts_firing, service_up/service_ready(service), service_replicas(_up), circuit_state, infra_up. Data flow: outbox_pending, outbox_oldest_age, outbox_dead, dlq_increase, kafka_consumer_lag. Resources: memory_ratio, memory_growth, db_pool_wait, disk_free_ratio. Trace one request: logs_by_request(request_id). Frontend (measured at Traefik): frontend_request_rate, frontend_5xx_ratio, frontend_latency_p95. The AI assistant itself: ai_runs_rate, ai_tokens_rate, ai_tool_errors, ai_llm_latency_p95, ai_rejected.

params.name: name
params.description: which named query to run

params.name: service
params.description: needed by service_up, service_ready, logs_errors

params.name: window
params.description: look-back window; each query has its own default

params.name: request_id
params.description: only for logs_by_request: the X-Request-ID to follow across services

admin.name: ops_list_playbooks

params.name: alert
params.description: alert name, e.g. OutboxDeadRows (from alerts_firing or an incident)

admin.name: ops_get_playbook
admin.description: One playbook: diagnose steps (read-only queries to run with ops_metrics_query), causes with the evidence that points to each, and the safe actions with their risk level. The actions are for the human to carry out; you cannot run them.

params.name: id
params.description: playbook id from ops_list_playbooks, e.g. outbox-stuck
